lots.guide_summary: All six close entries are SOLD Gowans hammers for boards of 3 to 5 mounted Tasmanian apple labels in the same presentation, Jun to Sep 2026: $15, $35, $40, $70, $90, $110 (median about $55). No UNSOLD or ASKING evidence (web search cap reached, eBay closed). Category outlier $440 for 16 labels not included in range. All AUD, rate 1.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $15 (lot 431017, five labels on board, Aug 2026). 15 / 1.198 = 12.52, round down to $10. Flip: likely resale about $55 (median of the six board sales); less 15% selling fees ($8.25) and $10 outbound postage = $36.75; / 2.396 = 15.34, round down to $15. Note flip exceeds keep only because keep is pinned to one weak sale; realistically do not chase past about $40 hammer ($48 all-in) even if keeping.
lots.confidence_reason: Labels read clearly in photo (Devon label: 'Exported by Hawker & Shadforth, Fancy, Tasmania... Australia', printer 'Cox Kay Print'), and six same-format Gowans sales were opened with photos viewed. Not High because none of the comparables are the same labels and the spread is wide ($15 to $110).
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped the aggregate '$10 to $60 typical range, aud 30' entry: it is a summary of many lots, not one sale. Dropped 435281 (bag of assorted labels, $360) and 395343 (folder of fruit and veg labels, $120): bulk lots, not comparable. All researcher prices and dates checked against the API and found correct.
lots.key_photo_findings: Single photo. Devon label clearly reads Hawker & Shadforth, Cox Kay Print (Hobart). Beaucaire shows fragments 'S...' and '...LTD.' under glare, consistent with Shadforth (Exports) Pty Ltd but not readable. Sunbeam, Red Ribbon and Blue Ribbon exporter lines hidden by overlap, so the claim that all five are H&S is not confirmed. Labels look unused and bright. Pencil vendor codes on the lot sticker only. Same mounting style as the Gowans 3-label boards sold this year.
lots.condition: Appears unused, bright colours, no visible tears; plastic glare hides parts of Beaucaire. Mounted on hardboard, unknown whether glued.
lots.question_for_gowans: Are the labels loose under the plastic or glued to the board, and do all five carry the Hawker & Shadforth exporter line?

lots.key_photo_findings: One photo. Round moulded-edge top with surface scratches and wear, deep apron, turned pedestal with ring collar, concave triform platform on turned bun feet. lots.question_for_gowans: What was the highest bid when lot 442174 passed in last week, and has the reserve been lowered? Is the top stable without pins, how were the feet repaired, and is it cedar or mahogany? Inspect at the viewing before bidding.
